title: Communication and Network Security learning paths

fast.method: Draw one network flow, annotate trust zones and protocol boundaries, then explain the selected channel and cloud/wireless controls.

standard.method: Study each unit, build a small reference network, and test the design against remote access, third-party, wireless, cloud, and failure scenarios.

reinforcement.method: Reconstruct trust zones, OSI/TCP-IP mappings, protocol protections, wireless/cloud boundaries, and endpoint admission decisions from memory.

completionEvidence: Can map a traffic flow to layers, planes, trust boundaries, and metrics
Can select component and endpoint controls proportionate to risk
Can explain secure remote, voice/video, data, and third-party channels with monitoring and failure considerations
